summary: Gold deepened its fear-zone slide Thursday as the dollar climbed to 102 and real 10-year yields held near 2.9%, keeping bullion under its 50-day average. Treasuries sold off further, pulling TLT down over 4% in two weeks and nudging equities off highs even with volatility low. Crypto stayed in greed, supported by Bitcoin's 30-day gain despite choppier short-term swings.
tweet: Dollar strength and rising real yields pushed gold deeper into fear Thursday, while bond losses pulled stocks off highs and crypto held its greed stance.
